description: This file defines the DesktopDevice class, which extends WebOrDesktopDevice and implements DesktopDeviceInterface. It manages device-specific functionalities such as keychain access, data synchronization, backups, and media permissions for desktop environments.

classes.name: DesktopDevice
classes.description: A class representing a desktop device, providing methods for keychain management, data synchronization, backups, and device-specific operations.

methods.name: getKeychainValue
methods.description: Retrieves the keychain value, either via native bridge or local storage.

methods.name: setKeychainValue
methods.description: Sets the keychain value through the native bridge or local storage.

methods.name: clearRawKeychainValue
methods.description: Clears the keychain value from the device.

methods.name: syncComponents
methods.description: Synchronizes components with the remote bridge.

methods.name: onMajorDataChange
methods.description: Notifies the remote bridge of major data changes.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Performs a search operation via the remote bridge.

methods.name: onInitialDataLoad
methods.description: Signals initial data load completion to the remote bridge.

methods.name: clearAllDataFromDevice
methods.description: Clears all data from the device and destroys all backups.

methods.name: downloadBackup
methods.description: Initiates a backup download process.

methods.name: localBackupsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of local backups.

methods.name: viewlocalBackups
methods.description: Views local backups.

methods.name: deleteLocalBackups
methods.description: Deletes local backups.

methods.name: isFilesBackupsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if file backups are enabled.

methods.name: enableFilesBackups
methods.description: Enables file backups.

methods.name: disableFilesBackups
methods.description: Disables file backups.

methods.name: changeFilesBackupsLocation
methods.description: Changes the location of file backups.

methods.name: getFilesBackupsLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the current file backups location.

methods.name: getFilesBackupsMappingFile
methods.description: Gets the mapping file for file backups.

methods.name: openFilesBackupsLocation
methods.description: Opens the file backups location.

methods.name: openFileBackup
methods.description: Opens a specific file backup.

methods.name: saveFilesBackupsFile
methods.description: Saves a file backup.

methods.name: getFileBackupReadToken
methods.description: Retrieves a read token for a file backup.

methods.name: readNextChunk
methods.description: Reads the next chunk of a file backup.

methods.name: performHardReset
methods.description: Performs a hard reset (not yet implemented).

methods.name: isDeviceDestroyed
methods.description: Checks if the device is destroyed.

methods.name: askForMediaAccess
methods.description: Requests media access permissions.
